data.name: Vault.Subtitle
data.value: Characters you keep outside any campaign. To play one, open a campaign's Cast and choose Bring a character.

data.name: Vault.SystemHint
data.value: A character can join only campaigns of this system. It can't be changed later.

data.name: Vault.EmptyBody
data.value: Make a character here to keep it for any campaign you join.

data.name: Vault.DeleteBody
data.value: It is deleted from your characters for good. Copies already in campaigns stay there.

data.name: Vault.StartConcept
data.value: A concept: the AI drafts the sheet and a history

data.name: Vault.ConceptPlaceholder
data.value: e.g. A former pirate turned temple guard, level 3.

data.name: Vault.ConceptHint
data.value: The AI picks only classes, species, gear and the rest from the server's Library for this system. Check the sheet afterwards.

data.name: Vault.NoAi
data.value: No AI model is set up for you. Add one under AI settings.

data.name: Vault.AiFailed
data.value: The AI could not draft a character: {0}

data.name: Vault.Data.Intro
data.value: Download everything of yours as one zip file: the characters here, the characters you play in other people's campaigns (as you see them), your private journals, and every campaign you run, with its pictures and its book. Keys and passwords are never in it.

data.name: Vault.Data.ImportHint
data.value: A downloaded zip, or the vault.json or played.json inside it. Its characters are added as new ones; any you have stay. A whole zip brings back only the characters that were here.

data.name: Vault.Data.TooBig
data.value: That file is too large to import.

data.name: Vault.Data.NotAVault
data.value: That file holds no characters to import.

data.name: Vault.Data.ImportedSome
data.value: Characters added: {0}. Left out, as their game system is not on this server: {1}.

data.name: Vault.Data.ImportFailed
data.value: The characters could not be imported: {0}

data.name: Vault.Delete.Body
data.value: Your account is deleted for good. This cannot be undone, so download your data first if you want a copy.

data.name: Vault.Delete.Owned
data.value: Campaigns you own, and the co-GM who takes each

data.name: Vault.Delete.NoCoGm
data.value: {0} has no other GM. Make a player a co-GM in its settings, or delete the campaign, first.

data.name: Vault.Delete.Leaves
data.value: You leave the other campaigns you are in ({0}). The characters you play there stay in those casts.

data.name: Vault.Delete.Goes
data.value: Gone with the account: the characters here ({0}), your private journals, world-builder chats and book builds.

data.name: Vault.Delete.Wrong
data.value: That was not your password (or name). Nothing was deleted.

data.name: Vault.Delete.NeedsOwner
data.value: Every campaign you own needs a co-GM to take it. Nothing was deleted.

data.name: Vault.Delete.LastAdmin
data.value: You are the server's only admin. Make someone else an admin first. Nothing was deleted.

data.name: Vault.Delete.LastAdminFirst
data.value: You are the server's only admin, so your account stays. Make someone else an admin on the admin page first.

data.name: Vault.Delete.Meanwhile
data.value: A campaign of yours appeared while your account was being deleted, so the account stays. Pass that campaign on, then delete again.
